findings.title: Use the account UI interpolation syntax instead of Java MessageFormat syntax
findings.body: This bundle is consumed by the account React UI, where the surrounding validation messages use `{{0}}`-style interpolation. Replacing this entry with Java `MessageFormat` syntax (`{0}` and `{2,choice,...}`) means the UI will not substitute the attribute and bounds and will display the choice expression literally when a multivalued attribute violates its size constraint. Keep the UI interpolation placeholders (or add the corresponding MessageFormat support before changing this bundle format).

findings.title: Use the admin UI interpolation syntax instead of Java MessageFormat syntax
findings.body: The admin UI message resources use `{{0}}` interpolation, as the prior value did. The new `{0}`/`{2,choice,...}` Java MessageFormat expression is not interpreted by the frontend localization layer, so multivalued attribute size validation errors in the admin console will expose raw placeholders and choice syntax instead of the supplied values.

findings.title: Lithuanian TOTP instruction was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `messages_lt.properties` is the Lithuanian account bundle, but the new `totpStep1` value is Italian ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare"). Lithuanian users will see an unrelated-language instruction during authenticator setup; replace it with a Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Lithuanian login TOTP instruction was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The `loginTotpStep1` entry in the Lithuanian login bundle now contains Italian text. This is displayed in the login-time OTP setup flow, so Lithuanian users receive an untranslated/wrong-language instruction. Supply the Lithuanian wording instead.

findings.title: Simplified-Chinese bundle now contains Traditional-Chinese text
findings.body: This is the `zh_CN` (Simplified Chinese) account bundle, but the replacement `totpStep1` uses Traditional Chinese characters such as `手機`, `應用程式`, and `以下`. This produces inconsistent localization for Simplified-Chinese users; use a Simplified-Chinese translation.
